response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers the cost of medication prescribed by a doctor for an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to excluded activities (clause A5.1, A5.2, A11.1, A11.2, A11.3, A11.4 do not apply here)."}
